• Contribuer aux études de sécurité des installations existantes et des nouveaux projets.

🔹 Sécurité thermique & analyse technique
• Interpréter les résultats d'essais de sécurité thermique tels que DSC, C80 et RC1.
• Identifier des solutions concrètes pour maîtriser les risques liés aux réactions chimiques et aux procédés industriels.
• Analyser des données techniques complexes et formuler des recommandations claires.

🔹 Ingénierie & projets industriels
• Participer aux revues de conception des équipements et des installations industrielles.
• Contribuer aux projets d'investissement et aux modifications d'installations sous l'angle de la sécurité des procédés.
• Veiller à la prise en compte des exigences de sécurité tout au long de la conception.

🔹 Gestion du changement & conformité
• Participer aux processus de gestion du changement (MOC).
• Évaluer l'impact sécurité procédés des modifications techniques et vérifier leur conformité aux exigences applicables.
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre et le suivi des standards de sécurité des procédés conformément à la politique EHS de l'entreprise.

🔹 Support aux opérations & à la maintenance
• Apporter un support technique aux équipes d'exploitation et de maintenance sur les sujets de sécurité des procédés.
• Apporter votre expertise sur des thématiques telles que l'inertage, les pressions, les températures et les compatibilités chimiques.
• Accompagner les équipes dans la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.

🔹 Audits, réglementation & études de sécurité
• Participer aux audits et inspections de conformité réglementaire.
• Contribuer aux analyses quantitatives des risques (QRA), aux études de protection contre les explosions et aux autres évaluations de sécurité.
• Veiller au respect des standards et réglementations applicables en matière de sécurité des procédés.

🔹 Formation & sensibilisation
• Former et sensibiliser le personnel aux principes et bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.
• Promouvoir une culture forte de la sécurité des procédés sur le site.
• Communiquer les exigences réglementaires et techniques aux interlocuteurs concernés.

Vos compétences

💼 Votre profil

• Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master en génie chimique, chimie ou domaine équivalent.
• Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en sécurité des procédés dans un environnement industriel chimique ou pharmaceutique.
• Expérience confirmée dans la réalisation d'études de sécurité des procédés.

• Bonne connaissance des standards internationaux de sécurité des procédés tels que API, CCPS, IEC 61511 et SEVESO.
• Capacité à lire et interpréter des P&ID, schémas de procédé et spécifications d'équipements.
• Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec l'aptitude à synthétiser des informations techniques complexes.
• Excellentes qualités de communication et capacités pédagogiques.
• Esprit d'équipe, proactivité et autonomie.
• Français courant et bon anglais technique, notamment pour la lecture et la rédaction de documents HSE internationaux.

Avantages

• 📍 Lieu : Genève, Suisse
• 🕒 Taux d'activité : 100 %

jobs.description:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

Deputy MLRO (AML Compliance)

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

About the role

Nu Global AG is Nu's Swiss entity, based in Zug. It went live in October 2026 with its AML/CFT and sanctions framework already in place: entity risk analysis, internal directives, customer risk classification, monitoring and screening standards, and MROS reporting. The same team also drives the next steps of Nu's expansion in Europe.

We are looking for a senior AML professional to act as deputy to the Head of AML/CFTP & Sanctions. In 2027 you will take over the day to day MLRO duties of the Swiss entity, so the Head of AML can focus on strategy, and you will help take the framework built in Switzerland to new markets in Europe, adapting it to the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6).

You will join a small, senior team where everyone owns their decisions and does the work themselves. You will work directly with senior management, the first line, our auditors and our regulators.

You'll be responsible for

  • Act as deputy to the AML Compliance Officer (MLRO) and stand in whenever needed

  • Run the day to day MLRO activities: escalated cases, decisions on reports to MROS under Art. 9 AMLA through goAML, and sanctions duties towards SECO, including asset freezes

  • Review and challenge the first line: sample based quality assurance of alert handling and case files, and sign off on changes to transaction monitoring rules and screening thresholds

  • Keep the framework current: entity risk analysis, internal directives and procedures, and the annual AML/CFT report to the Board

  • Issue the financial crime opinion on new products, features and material changes at the Product Risk Committee

  • Be the point of contact for our SRO, MROS, SECO and the external AML auditor, and for due diligence requests from partner and correspondent institutions

  • Own the AML/CFT training plan and the training duty under Art. 8 AMLA

  • As Nu expands in Europe, adapt the Swiss framework to the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6) and turn it into binding control requirements for product, engineering and operations

We are looking for someone who has

  • Served as MLRO, AML Compliance Officer or formal deputy at a regulated financial intermediary in Switzerland, supervised by FINMA or an SRO, or in the EU (mandatory)

  • Lives in Switzerland today (mandatory)

  • Meets the fit and proper requirements that regulators apply to AML officers (mandatory)

  • Holds the CAMS certification (mandatory)

  • Speaks fluent English, our working language, and fluent German (mandatory)

  • Has practical experience with the Swiss AML framework (AMLA, AMLO, FINMA AMLO and SRO rules, MROS and SECO reporting), the EU AML framework, or both, and a working knowledge of the new EU AML package (AMLR and AMLD6)

  • Has built or set up an AML function or framework

  • Has taken and defended reporting and freezing decisions, and has dealt directly with FINMA, SROs, other regulators and external auditors

  • Has reviewed and challenged first line controls at a senior level: transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, KYC and customer risk classification

  • Writes clearly and precisely in policies, opinions and regulatory correspondence

Nice to have

  • Sanctions expertise: screening, list management, asset freezes and reporting under Swiss and EU sanctions regimes

  • Experience with international remittances and cross border payments

  • Travel Rule compliance, including for digital assets

  • Experience in a fintech or in a newly authorised financial institution

  • Comfort using data and AI tools to review alerts, test controls and draft documentation

  • Other certifications such as CGSS, CCAS, Chainalysis Reactor or Chainalysis KYT (recommended)

Location for this opportunity

  • Zug, Switzerland (you must live in Switzerland today)

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Health Insurance Allowance for you and your dependents

  • Pension Plan

  • Accident Insurance

  • Daily Sickness Benefits

  • Life Insurance & Death Benefits

  • NuCare – Employee Assistance Programme, available 24/7 for you and your dependents

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • International Travel Insurance for business trips

  • Work-from-home Allowance and office equipment for working from home

  • Parking space at the Zug office

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

jobs.title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
jobs.description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

jobs.title: Senior Stack Scientist
jobs.description:
Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

  • Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

  • Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

  • Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

  • Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

  • Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

  • Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required

  • PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

  • 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

  • Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

  • Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

  • Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

  • Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

  • Management experience

  • English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

Start date: Immediately

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on, resourceful Recruiting & HR Operations Manager to help us attract, hire, and support exceptional talent as we grow. This role will primarily focus on full-cycle recruiting, partnering closely with hiring managers and leadership to understand business needs, build talent pipelines, and deliver an efficient, high-quality candidate experience.

While recruiting will be the priority, this role will support onboarding, employee lifecycle administration, and day-to-day HR operations for our Swiss-based team when time allows. Reporting to the Fractional HR leader based in the US, you will help build scalable, consistent people practices while providing responsive support to employees and managers.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys quick execution to make an impact, owning the details, building relationships, and balancing multiple priorities in a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting for positions across the organization, from intake meetings and sourcing through interviews, offers, and closing candidates.

  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, develop recruiting strategies, and establish clear selection criteria.

  • Source candidates through LinkedIn, professional networks, referrals, and other creative channels.

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs.

  • Coordinate interview processes, ensuring timely communication, structured evaluations, and a positive candidate experience.

  • Manage offer processes, including compensation coordination, offer approvals, and preparation of employment contracts in partnership with HR and leadership.

  • Track recruiting metrics, pipeline health, time-to-fill, and other key indicators to identify opportunities to improve hiring effectiveness.

  • Maintain accurate applicant tracking system records and recruiting documentation.

  • Support the development of consistent recruiting practices across locations while accounting for local market expectations.

HR Operations

  • Coordinate preboarding and onboarding activities, including background checks, system entry, equipment, relocation coordination, and orientation.

  • Partner with hiring managers and cross-functional teams to ensure new employees have a smooth, engaging start.

  • Support new-hire check-ins and identify opportunities to improve the onboarding experience.

  • Support employee lifecycle processes, including new hires, employment changes, internal transfers, and departures.

  • Assist with HR reporting, audits, and other operational projects as needed.

  • Coordinate with external payroll providers, benefits partners, and local HR or employment advisors as needed.

  • Support compliance with applicable Swiss employment requirements and internal policies in partnership with the Fractional HR leader and relevant local experts.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with the Fractional HR leader to prioritize recruiting and people initiatives aligned with business objectives.

  • Build trusted relationships with employees, hiring managers, and cross-functional partners.

  • Handle confidential employee and candidate information with discretion and sound judgment.

  • Contribute to the development of consistent, scalable HR processes in a growing organization while recognizing the need for locally appropriate practices.

Desired Skills and Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting, talent acquisition, and/or HR operations, ideally in a growing technology, energy, engineering, or other technical organization.

  • Demonstrated success managing multiple open requisitions and delivering a strong candidate experience.

  • Experience recruiting for technical, commercial, operational, or corporate roles; experience in engineering or energy-related hiring is a plus.

  • Familiarity with Swiss employment practices and HR administration, or experience supporting employees in Switzerland.

  • Fluency in English; professional proficiency in French is strongly preferred given the location in Nyon and the potential need to support local employees and external partners.

  • Experience with applicant tracking systems (Ashby preferred), HRIS platforms (HiBob), and standard productivity tools.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently.

  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and willingness to roll up your sleeves to get things done.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain confidentiality.

jobs.title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer - Fuel Cell Systems
jobs.description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help achieve our vision of a decarbonised future we are seeking a Functional Safety Engineer to embed safety into our fuel cell systems, leading hazard analysis and safety engineering across hardware, software and controls to ensure our products are safe, compliant and certifiable.

This role requires full-time, on-site presence at our Nyon, Switzerland office. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be prepared to relocate.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the functional safety lifecycle for fuel cell systems from concept to release

• Lead hazard and risk analyses (HARA, HAZOP, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA) and define safety goals

• Derive safety requirements and concepts and allocate them across hardware, software and controls

• Define/verify safety mechanisms, diagnostics and safe states with the controls and embedded teams

• Perform safety analyses and calculations (SIL/PL/ASIL determination, metrics, PFH/PFD)

• Compile safety cases, safety plans and supporting documentation for certification

• Interface with notified bodies, certification authorities and customers on safety topics

• Promote a strong safety culture and coach teams on functional safety practices

 

Skills and Experience Required:

• BSc/MSc in electrical, electronic, mechatronic, control or safety engineering is mandatory

• Minimum 3-5 years of functional safety experience in industrial, energy or hydrogen systems

• Working knowledge of safety standards (ex. IEC 61508, ISO 13849, ISO 26262 and/or IEC 62061)

• Hands-on experience with HARA, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA and safety requirements engineering

• Understanding of safety-related hardware, embedded software and control architectures

• Familiarity with hydrogen, high-voltage or pressure system safety is a strong plus

• Team player able to work autonomously with internal and external experts

• Excellent spoken and written English is mandatory; French/German is a plus

• Functional safety certification (e.g. TÜV FSEng) is a plus

 

Start date: Immediately

jobs.title: Senior Control Engineer
jobs.description:
About EH Energy

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

Please note we would require you to be onsite, full-time in Switzerland. For details on the visa requirements for relocating to this exceptional Swiss canton, please get in touch and a member of our team will be happy to advise.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems

  • Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs

  • Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7

  • Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems

  • Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic

  • Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products

  • Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures

  • Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management

  • Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements

  • Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization

  • Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

 

Skills and Experience Required:

  • BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role

  • Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus

  • Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements

  • Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions

  • Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management

Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.

This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?

Most tools start and stop with dashboards. We start with the hard part: turning fragmented, messy enterprise data into a consistent foundation people can trust. Then we use AI to make it conversational, so anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer they can act on.

We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.

We're hiring a business development leader to take over the team that builds and runs our investor network: six associates, one number, and a direct line to both co-founders.

The two co-founders have led this team themselves until now. It has grown to around six associates, which is past the point where two founders can coach it hands on while running the rest of the company, so we are hiring the person who takes it over.

You lead the investor relations team and report to both co-founders. Each associate holds a book of investor members and runs several things at once, new investor relationships, the nurturing of existing ones, and the introductions we make for our clients, plus the follow-up work from there. Your job is to make that team excellent and keep it at full leverage, which means every associate knows what is expected, gets coached every week, can measure their own progress, and hears it the same day when something is off.

  • Coach every associate on their calls and their introductions.

  • Own the health of the entire Pairs network, more active members every month, and every member getting founders that fit at the pace they asked for.

  • Work with our client success team on each client's plan, so what your team works on matches what the client expects, and with our founder relations team, who build relationships with top founders long before they become clients.

  • Spot the constraint that holds the team back and fix it, with a process or together with our engineers, which takes someone who knows which problem is worth solving.

  • Bring the two co-founders the weekly numbers, investor calls, newly active members, introductions sent, founder calls and referrals, and what you are changing because of them.


What you bring

  • You have run a sales, business development or investment team of five or more for at least two years, the number you carried was the team's, and you can name what the team achieved under you and who you promoted.

  • People respected you and still wanted to work for you, without you needing to be liked. You give straight feedback and you hold the standard when it is uncomfortable.

  • Ego and politics are not part of how you work. You talk about the team's results before your own, and your last team would say the same about you.

  • Systems are how you think. You have built the CRM discipline, the reporting or the playbook that others then ran on, and you can find the one constraint in a team and remove it.

  • Incentives and retention make sense to you. You know what makes the right behavior pay and what makes a team stick together, and you have the retention to show for it.

  • You play the long game. You would not squeeze one month at the cost of the next three, and you go for quality over quantity with investors and founders alike.

  • The investor world is one you know well enough to coach. You have sold high ticket to senior buyers, raised capital, or built an investor or executive network yourself, and years in venture capital or at a fund are a plus on top of the team you led.

  • Ninety days in, the weekly rhythm runs on your numbers and every associate has a written plan they measure themselves against.

  • Every month the network has more active members and every client's introductions went out on fit and on time.

  • Every quarter one constraint is gone from the team's way, through a process or through engineering.

  • After a year the associates have grown, and the relationships with investors and founders are stronger than they were, since everything here is built to compound over years.

US$200K to US$300K+ total compensation, base plus a bonus on the team's results. Fully remote, your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours. Hit apply, which takes you to a short form with four questions. The two co-founders read every application. The process from there is a first call, final conversations with both co-founders, and three references.

BeyondMath is a pioneering startup, backed by top-tier VCs, on a mission to reshape the frontiers of engineering through Foundational AI models for Physics. We are replacing traditional, slow, and expensive simulation methods with AI that rivals accuracy at orders of magnitude higher speed.

We are moving beyond the "generic AI" hype to solve the world's hardest physical engineering challenges in automotive, consumer electronics, aerospace, and energy. We are looking for a Marketing Manager to be our first dedicated marketing hire: a hands-on operator who will build and run the channels, materials and events that put our technology in front of the engineers who need it.

The Role

As Marketing Manager, you are the person who makes BeyondMath's marketing actually happen. This is an execution role, not a strategy role: you will report to our GTM Lead, who sets direction with the CEO and COO, and you own turning it into a steady, high-quality stream of output across our social channels, our go-to-market materials and our events calendar.

You will work closely with the leadership team, our GTM and technical account teams, and our engineers and researchers, turning deeply technical work with global OEMs, Formula 1 teams and aerospace innovators into content and moments the market notices. You will not inherit a marketing machine; you will build one, with real autonomy, a direct line to leadership, and the BeyondMath brand system already in place to work from.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Our Social Channels: Run BeyondMath's LinkedIn and other relevant channels day to day — content calendar, copy, visuals, scheduling, community engagement and reporting — with a consistent voice and an on-brand look.

  • Content Production: Turn product releases, customer results, research and team news into posts, short articles, case studies, one-pagers and short-form video, working directly with engineers and researchers to get the technical detail right.

  • GTM Materials & Preparation: Support the GTM team with decks, one-pagers, proposals, demo collateral and follow-up materials, and maintain a current library of on-brand templates they can pick up and use.

  • Events Calendar & Attendance: Own the events calendar across industry conferences, partner events and executive dinners or roundtables. Plan BeyondMath's presence end to end: selection and budget, sponsorships, speaker slots, booth and materials, logistics, attendee outreach, onsite execution and post-event follow-up and reporting.

  • Owned Events & Webinars: Produce BeyondMath-hosted moments — technical webinars, customer roundtables, launch events — from concept through follow-up.

  • Website, Email & Digital: Keep website content current (news, case studies, careers), look after basic SEO hygiene, and run newsletter and email communications to prospects and partners.

  • Brand Guardianship: Apply and maintain the BeyondMath brand guidelines across all internal and external materials, and brief and manage freelancers or agencies (design, video, PR) where needed.

  • Measurement: Track channel, content and event performance, report simply on what is working, and keep marketing data in the CRM clean and usable for the GTM team.

About You

  • You have a "founder's mentality": you are a builder who is comfortable being the first person in a function, and who will set up the system and then run it yourself.

  • You take pride in output. You would rather ship ten strong posts and two excellent events than write one strategy deck.

  • You are at home with deeply technical subject matter and genuinely curious about engineering, simulation and AI. You do not need to be an engineer, but you need to enjoy working with them.

  • You are organised, detail-obsessed and reliable across many concurrent deadlines, and you bring a calm, can-do attitude to a fast-moving team.

Essential Requirements

  • Experience: 3–7 years' B2B marketing experience, ideally in a startup or scale-up and ideally in technology, software, engineering or deep tech.

  • Social Channel Ownership: A hands-on track record running company social channels, LinkedIn in particular — content calendars, copywriting, visuals, community management and analytics.

  • Events Delivery: Proven experience planning and delivering B2B events and conference attendance end to end, including sponsorships, logistics and onsite execution.

  • Writing: Strong writing and editing. You produce clean, accurate copy quickly and can work with engineers to make complex things clear without dumbing them down.

  • Tooling: Working proficiency in presentation and design tools (PowerPoint or Google Slides, Canva or Figma) and everyday marketing tooling (CRM and email, social scheduling, web analytics).

  • AI-Native: Fluent, daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) across your marketing workflow.

  • Travel: Willing and able to travel for events across the UK and Europe, with occasional travel further afield.

Highly Desirable

  • Technical Audiences: Experience marketing to engineering, manufacturing or industrial audiences (automotive, aerospace, energy, motorsport), or within CAE, simulation or engineering software.

  • First Marketer: Experience as the sole or first marketing hire in a company.

  • Video: Short-form video production and editing for social.

  • CRM & Web: Working knowledge of a B2B CRM and a website CMS.

  • PR: Experience with press, media relations and announcements.

Why Join Us?

  • Full Ownership: You will own how BeyondMath shows up in the market — our channels, our materials and our events — and build the marketing function from the ground up.

  • High Impact: Your work puts our technology in front of the engineers designing the next generation of sustainable transport and energy systems.

  • Elite Team: Work alongside veterans from world-leading AI labs and top-tier engineering teams in a culture of "impact with integrity."

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Signal AI, we use cutting-edge AI technology to offer clarity on decisions that shape businesses and society. We value restless curiosity, creative thinking, and diverse perspectives as we strive to become AI-native. We believe that AI is a collaborator, not just a tool, and we invite passionate individuals to join us on our journey as we continue to learn, experiment, and grow together.

About the role

Engineers at Signal AI are expected to bring a strong product mindset to their work. They’re comfortable with complex problems and proactively look for ambiguous ones rather than wait for others to resolve them, and work wherever the product needs them across the full stack. Engineers work closely with other disciplines, including applied research and design, as part of teams that own revenue-critical products from ideation through to production.

Owning a product end to end means much of an engineer’s time goes on understanding the problem: talking to colleagues in research, design and product, testing assumptions, and deciding what is worth building.

Our engineering teams are organised around the needs of the business. We value collaboration and teamwork, and we believe the best solutions to complex problems come from working together. You will work primarily within a small cross-functional team, contributing to its architecture and to engineering standards. You will provide clear, focused technical plans for current and future solutions, and you will keep the long-term technical vision in view.

AI-assisted development is part of everyday work across the organisation. We expect engineers to use tools like Claude Code to move quickly across the entire software development lifecycle, so more of their time is spent on the product questions that matter.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building intuitive user interfaces and data visualisations that unlock valuable insights for our customers.

  • Building services that can cope with large volumes of data.

  • Implementing and maintaining the AWS infrastructure that supports the services owned by the team.

  • Build, maintain and evolve large-scale distributed systems, ensuring they remain resilient.

  • Building observability into everything you ship (logging, metrics, alerting).

  • Owning BAU in your primary domain and building enough operational familiarity with the other domains to support incidents, understand cross-domain interactions, and describe architectural boundaries.

  • Collaborating with Product and Design to define and scope the products we build.

  • Communicating with other teams and stakeholders when needed.

  • Working in a collaborative environment. Pairing for most of your time, giving and receiving reviews, and helping to uphold the team’s shared quality standard.

Working with AI

This is not specifically an AI Engineer role, but every senior engineer in this team is expected to be AI-literate, in two directions: using AI to build better, and building AI into the product responsibly.

  • Keep your practice current. Use current models, coding agents and agent tooling in your daily work, and re-test earlier assumptions as capabilities change; what was unreliable six months ago may be routine today.

  • Open mind, evidence-led. Give a new tool, pattern or model a fair chance and evaluate it against our own codebases and workflows before ruling it out. Push back when something is presented as a silver bullet and adopting it would bring more risk, or more change, than the team can absorb. Make both calls on evidence, not on instinct or hype.

  • Quality bar parity. Agent-generated code and content are held to the same standard as human work. Review it, test it and secure it the same way.

  • Build to learn. A working prototype in front of a Product owner or a customer beats a slide. Be as willing to report a disappointing result as an exciting one, and kill weak ideas early.

  • Design the human checkpoints and watch the cost. For agentic features, define what the system may decide alone, what needs approval and what escalates, and keep token and run costs visible alongside the value delivered.

  • Share what you learn. Contribute to how the team adopts AI across the whole lifecycle (planning, review, testing and release, not only coding) and share your findings with the team and the wider P&T group, so practice spreads beyond one person.

The Signal AI Way

We want you to apply for this position. We want people to enjoy a good experience at Signal AI and we appreciate your professional needs might be different to what we can offer.

  • Thriving in Dynamic Environments: If you thrive on stability and predictability, you might find our dynamic environment challenging. Our team frequently adapts to changing priorities, which can be incredibly exciting and rewarding for those who enjoy a fast-paced, ever-evolving workplace.

  • Versatile Skill Set: We value versatility and the ability to work on both back-end and front-end development, and across two product domains. If you are passionate about expanding your skills across different areas, you'll find this role enriching and fulfilling.

  • Collaborative Communication: Our culture emphasises building strong communication paths with various teams and stakeholders, including the Editorial team that depends on our tooling every day. If you enjoy collaborative problem-solving and sharing insights, you'll fit right in.

  • Team-Oriented Programming: We encourage pair programming and team collaboration over solo work. If you find joy in teamwork and learning from peers, you'll thrive here.

  • Flexible Coding Approaches: While we respect the discipline of TDD, we also appreciate flexible and innovative approaches to coding, and we prioritise observability over exhaustive test coverage. If you're open to experimenting with different methodologies, this role offers a great opportunity to broaden your horizons.

  • Leveraging AI: We're not just building AI products; we use AI to build better. We expect our engineers to actively explore and adopt AI tools that make them more productive, and to keep their critical thinking switched on while doing it.

  • Owning Our Systems: When something goes wrong in production, we don't point fingers. We fix it, learn from it, and improve our observability to catch it earlier next time.

If these aspects align with your professional values and aspirations, we believe you'll find a rewarding career with us at Signal AI.

About Signal

At Signal we want to help organisations identify risks and opportunities and see movements in the market before anyone else. We want to help leaders make bold decisions, safe that the data is on their side. We want to connect all those external data points together, uncover the unknown unknowns, and be at the very heart of the knowledge economy.

We’ve already built a world-class artificial intelligence platform for real-time information aggregation and analysis at a massive scale. We proved our value with monitoring and measurement products in the PR & Comms space, and are now joining the dots beyond.

We are friendly and informal people who are passionate about our brand as we all have a stake in our success. We have an inclusive environment, welcoming the skills and experience from many diverse backgrounds, and together we have created who we are and what we sell. We are proud of our achievements and continue to strive for the unknown.

Not sure you meet every requirement? Studies show that women and other underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they check every box. At Signal AI, diverse perspectives strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and lead to better performance. So even if your background doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we encourage you to apply if you’re passionate about this role.

We're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every Signaller feels welcomed, valued, and heard—a place where you can truly thrive as yourself.

Nevoya is North America's leading next-generation electric trucking carrier, transforming logistics through AI-native operations and relentless customer focus. The company builds and uses proprietary technology to deliver zero-emissions carrier services to Fortune 500 shippers with superior economics and service to legacy diesel operators. The company has operations in California and Texas, and is backed by globally-renowned investors including Lowercarbon Capital.

About the Role:

This is a foundational hire. You will do different aspects of dispatching in trucking — without needing any trucking experience. You’ll keep real freight moving for real customers: assigning loads, communicating with drivers, handling exceptions, and solving the problems of the day.

The reason this works is you. You are AI-native — AI is your default way of researching, troubleshooting, and getting work done — and you have the critical thinking to notice when the playbook is wrong and the initiative to propose the fix. You’ll work directly with engineering and product to automate the repetitive parts of the job, so the role keeps getting smarter.

You’ll get a lot of direction, coaching, and ownership early. Do this well and the role is a launchpad: people who build the operational foundation here will grow into bigger roles across the company.

  • Use AI tools daily to research, troubleshoot, draft, analyze, and automate your own work

What You’ll Bring:

  • Sharp critical thinking — you spot what’s broken, ask why, and bring a proposed answer

  • Hungry and coachable: you want direction, feedback, and a steep learning curve

  • Strong written and verbal communication — you’ll be talking to drivers, customers, and engineers in the same hour

Nice to Have:

jobs.title: Founding GTM
jobs.description:
Company

Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI.

 

We develop ultra-low-latency voice models that enable super-realistic, human-like speech directly on devices. Our focus is on building efficient generative audio models and infrastructure that can run on CPU-constrained hardware, enabling real-time voice interaction without relying on large cloud infrastructure.

 

By dramatically reducing latency and compute requirements, we're making natural conversational AI possible on phones, embedded devices, browsers, and edge systems. This requires building high-performance systems that bridge machine learning, real-time audio processing, and distributed infrastructure.

 

Neuphonic was founded in April 2024 and has raised significant funding from leading European investors. We work with global enterprises across hardware and consumer AI that are building the next generation of voice-enabled products. Our open source models have been downloaded over 4 million times and earned over 6,500 GitHub stars since launch.

 

Our vision is a world where voice becomes the most natural interface for AI, enabling seamless, intuitive interactions that are accessible to everyone.

 

Role

We're looking for a Founding GTM Associate to build the top of our enterprise pipeline, working side by side with our founders and sales team.

 

Our go-to-market runs from open source to enterprise. Developers find and build on our open models, and the companies they work for need production-grade, supported versions for products where latency, privacy and offline operation matter. Your job is to make that path faster and more predictable.

 

This is a hands-on, commercial role with one clear goal: book as many qualified meetings as possible for our sales team. You'll report to the CEO and work directly with the founders, research team and sales team.

 

We are not looking for a marketer measured on impressions. We're looking for someone commercially sharp, comfortable reaching out to people, and technical enough to hold their own with engineers.

 

Your work will include:

  • Identifying which companies are using our open models, researching them, and getting the right ones into a conversation with sales

  • Running targeted outreach to engineering and product leaders at our target accounts, by email, LinkedIn and through our community

  • Booking meetings directly with prospects and handing them over to our account executives with clear context

  • Building target account lists for events, dinners and conferences, and following up within 48 hours after

  • Creating the assets that open doors: account research, tailored demos, one-pagers and case studies

  • Supporting open source launches and creator partnerships so they generate pipeline, not just attention

  • Tracking which channels produce meetings, and recommending where we put more time and budget

  • Helping build the GTM processes and playbooks we'll scale as the team grows

 

In your first few months, the priority is turning companies already using our models into meetings. Events, launches and creator partnerships grow from there. Open source is our biggest advantage, but we care about meetings, not channels. If paid, LinkedIn or outbound gets better results, we want you to prove it and run with it.

 

This is a role to learn fast in. You'll see how an enterprise AI company is built from the inside, and as our GTM team scales, there's a clear path for you to lead part of it.

 

You have:

  • 1–3 years' experience in sales development, B2B sales, consulting, a startup generalist role or another demanding commercial environment

  • Strong commercial instincts: you can spot which companies are worth our time, and explain why

  • Comfort reaching out to people you don't know, and following up until you get a response

  • Sharp written communication: emails people answer, and briefs our sales team can act on

  • Enough technical curiosity to run our models, follow an engineering conversation and learn fast

  • Comfort being measured on one clear number, with the judgement to protect meeting quality while chasing volume

  • Comfort testing new channels quickly and dropping what doesn't work

  • A proactive approach and comfort building from scratch

 

Bonus points for experience in AI, speech or edge computing, booking meetings for an enterprise sales team, or working in a CRM day to day.

 

This probably isn't the right role for you if you're looking for a marketing or brand role, or if you'd rather support deals than create them.

 

How we'll measure success:

Success means a reliable, growing flow of qualified enterprise meetings for our sales team.

 

We'll look at:

  • Accepted meetings per month: meetings that are held and that an account executive confirms as a real opportunity

  • Meeting-to-opportunity rate, so volume never comes at the expense of quality

  • Pipeline created from the meetings you source

  • Cost per accepted meeting across channels

 

Location:

  • London (King's Cross)

  • In the office 5 days a week

  • 10am–6pm are our usual in-office working hours

 

Compensation and benefits:

  • Help us set the company culture - you'd be joining us as part of our founding team. Help us set and guide the company culture! Whether it's breakfasts or games nights, give us your ideas and we'll make it happen together.

  • Competitive salary and equity - we want to make sure you're rewarded not just in financial terms but also have a sizeable stake in the business as well. We're in this together.

  • Private health insurance - your health and well-being is paramount. We want to make sure that everyone in the company is supported when it comes to health.

  • Conference, travel and development budget - your development will also grow the business. We want to make sure that you have access to the resources and opportunities you need to be at your best.

  • AI tools budget - we're an AI company, and we want you using the best tools available to move faster.

  • MacBook and the latest equipment

jobs.title: Mobile Service Engineer – North England/Scotland
jobs.description:
Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're scaling rapidly and need a skilled Mobile Service Engineer to look after our growing estate across the North of England and Scotland.

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on and proactive Mobile Service Engineer to manage the maintenance and overall health of our car park infrastructure across the North of England and Scotland, ensuring that downtime on sites due to equipment failure is kept to a minimum. You'll be responsible for the ongoing maintenance of existing sites and the coordination of subcontractors to keep operations running seamlessly. The role calls for a mix of technical expertise, knowledge of CCTV/ANPR cameras and a problem-solving mindset, with regular site visits to either oversee or carry out maintenance work.

Location & Travel

This is a field-based role covering our northern estate, from Leeds up to Scotland. The ideal candidate will be based between Leeds and Dundee, and must be able to travel regularly to sites across all of our northern locations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Equipment maintenance: Maintain ANPR cameras, Pay & Display machines, tablets, signage and other related equipment.

  • RAMS: Ensure Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS) are prepared and followed when on site.

  • Signage & frontline maintenance: Install and replace signage and kiosk consumables as required, ensuring compliance with safety and operational standards.

  • Issue resolution: Diagnose and resolve technical issues on site, ensuring all equipment functions optimally.

  • Compliance & safety: Adhere to all safe working procedures and compliance guidelines, ensuring a safe and effective work environment.

  • Site visits: Visit sites across the North of England and Scotland on a scheduled basis to carry out general site health checks.

  • Proactive monitoring: Plan and execute regular site visits and maintenance schedules across the northern estate to maintain a high-quality estate.

  • Subcontractor coordination: Coordinate subcontractors on site to ensure maintenance and project work is delivered on time.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Background in hands-on installation, ideally from companies or industries such as Sky, CCTV, BT, Field IT or IoT-related roles. (ANPR experience is beneficial but not required.)

  • Experience working with subcontractors to ensure projects meet deadlines.

  • Ability to work independently, making on-the-spot decisions to meet project objectives.

  • Experience producing site documentation, such as site maps and install plans.

  • Comfortable working alone, following installation plans and survey documents.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to multitask and adapt to dynamic site conditions.

  • Based between Leeds and Dundee, and able to travel regularly across all of our sites in the North of England and Scotland.

  • Full, clean UK driving licence (essential).

  • Basic knowledge of Risk Assessments and RAMS documentation.

Desirable Qualifications / Certificates

  • Asbestos Awareness

  • Abrasive Wheels Certification

  • Working at Height Certification

  • Ladder Safety Training

  • Health & Safety Awareness

  • C&G 2365 (Electrical Installation)

  • CAT & Genny Training

  • IPAF (Powered Access Equipment)

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary & benefits: Reflective of your experience and designed to support your professional growth and well-being.

  • Company van for site travel.

  • Company pension, sick pay and on-site parking.

  • Flexible, home-based working: Split your time between home and our sites across the North of England and Scotland.

Why Hozah?

Every site runs on ANPR cameras, payment kiosks, edge devices and 4G connectivity, and all of it has to work around the clock. The TechOps team keeps that estate healthy, and we are looking for a junior engineer to join it.

The role

You will be hands-on from day one, helping to monitor, maintain and fix the technology running in car parks across the country. When a camera drops offline, a kiosk misbehaves or a site stops reporting data, you will be part of the team that works out why and puts it right, usually remotely.

You will learn a genuinely broad set of skills in one role: networking, IoT devices, monitoring, APIs, databases and cloud systems, all on a live estate where your work has visible impact the same day.   • Monitoring the health of cameras, kiosks and network equipment across 150+ car parks, and acting when something looks wrong.

  • Keeping inventory, configuration records and documentation accurate and up to date.

  • Managing your tickets in Jira with clear notes, sensible prioritisation and proper follow-through.

  • Learning constantly: from the TechOps team, from our developers, and from the estate itself.

  • Solid Windows knowledge: event logs, command line, system configuration.

  • Corporate IT support. The users of our systems are cameras and cars, and the work is looking after a distributed technology estate.

  • A dead end. The team is growing, the estate is growing, and there is a clear path to more senior TechOps work as you develop.

Salary, location and working pattern

  • 4 days a week in our Croydon office, 1 day from home, with occasional site visits.

Half your week is leading our TechOps engineers: running 1:1s, setting standards, managing KPIs, coaching, and owning the service desk. You decide how technical problems get diagnosed and resolved at Hozah, and you hold the team to that standard.

The other half is hands-on engineering. The systems are built in house, so there is no vendor to escalate to. What you’ll be doing

Schneller Vertrieb: Klassischer SMB-Sales: Dein Team gewinnt Unternehmer:innen und Finanzverantwortliche in SME – kurze Entscheidungswege, hohe Schlagzahl, überzeugende Demos. Ihr zeigt konkret, wie Pennylane den Finanzalltag eines Unternehmens vereinfacht.

Standort Berlin: Das Team wird aus unserem Berliner Office geführt – du bist an zwei Tagen pro Woche vor Ort, den Rest flexibel. Präsenz ist Teil deiner Führung: Du coachst deine AEs im Office Seite an Seite und begleitest sie bei wichtigen Kunden vor Ort – etwa zehn Reisen pro Jahr in die Regionen deines Teams.

Du wirst für die Leistung dieses Teams verantwortlich sein durch:

  • Du verantwortest die Vertriebsleistung deines Teams – gemessen am MRR aus deutschen SME – und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum im deutschen SME-Markt.

  • Du schaffst klare Erwartungen, coachst regelmäßig anhand konkreter Kundengespräche und nutzt Pipeline- und Conversion-Daten, um dein Team gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of Sales den Go-to-Market-Ansatz für SME weiter (Inside Sales, Demos, Onboarding) und setzt ihn mit deinem Team um.

  • Du baust die Prozesse deines Teams auf – vom Sales-Playbook über Forecasting bis zur Pipeline-Steuerung.

  • Du begleitest deine AEs bei strategischen Demos und Key Deals – per Video-Call und vor Ort.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem französischen Sales-Team zusammen und überträgst, was vom Playbook für Deutschland funktioniert.

Als Team Lead Sales – SME sind deine Ziele vielfältig:

  • Du erreichst die Vertriebsziele des Teams und steuerst das Tagesgeschäft – mit einem Aktivitätsniveau, das die individuellen und gemeinsamen Ziele erreichbar macht.

  • Du verantwortest das Sales Enablement deiner Account Executives: Techniken, Messaging und der gesamte Pennylane-Sales-Prozess.

  • Du begleitest neue AEs durch Onboarding und Ramp-up und führst sie zu ihren Zielen.

  • Du baust Teamgeist, Engagement und Wohlbefinden auf – mit Challenges, Teambuildings und Formaten, die du selbst gestaltest.

  • Du bringst die Perspektive des SME-Vertriebs in die Sales-OKRs von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

  • Du gehst bei wichtigen Deals selbst mit rein – per Video-Call oder vor Ort beim Kunden.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung als Account Executive im B2B-SaaS-Sales mit – idealerweise im SMB-Segment mit kurzen Deal-Zyklen und hoher Schlagzahl – und hast mindestens zwei Jahre ein Sales-Team (AEs / Full-Cycle) erfolgreich geführt.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst das Fintech- oder B2B-SaaS-Ökosystem – oder hast an Unternehmer:innen und Finanzverantwortliche in SME verkauft. Wenn nicht, bringst du die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du führst über Coaching: Du entwickelst Menschen anhand echter Kundengespräche, mit Daten, klarem Feedback und dem Mut, Entscheidungen zu treffen und durchzuhalten.

  • Du besitzt ein unternehmerisches Mindset, fühlst dich in einem noch nicht vollständig strukturierten Umfeld wohl und hast Lust, Dinge von Grund auf aufzubauen.

  • Du bist offen für Selbstreflexion und fühlst dich wohl dabei, Feedback zu geben und zu empfangen.

  • Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen – Marketing, Customer Success, Product und dem französischen HQ.

  • Du bist hands-on: Du führst nicht nur vom Dashboard aus, sondern gehst selbst mit in Deals – und hast weiterhin Lust, selbst zu verkaufen, um den Markt zu kennen.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau – deine Kund:innen sind deutsche Unternehmer:innen – und sicheres Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris.

  • Du lebst in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu ziehen – und du bist gern vor Ort: zwei Tage pro Woche im Berliner Office und rund zehn Reisen pro Jahr zu AEs und Kunden in den Regionen.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • 🏢 Berlin, hybrid: zwei Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel.

  • 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

  • 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus variabler Anteil, gekoppelt an den MRR, den dein Team erzielt.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln.

  • 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Sales-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (alle 3 Monate) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar – plus Team-Events in Berlin.

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive
jobs.description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive, you will drive Zip’s expansion into global enterprises with $7B+ in revenue. This is a high-impact, consultative sales role requiring deep industry expertise, a hunter mentality, and a passion for solving complex procurement challenges.

 

You Will

  • Own the full sales cycle: Engage C-level executives, influence stakeholders across procurement, finance, IT, legal, and operations, and navigate long, complex deal cycles.

  • Drive new business: While supported by BDRs and marketing, you’ll proactively prospect and leverage your network to develop a strong pipeline.

  • Act as a strategic advisor: Understand enterprise procurement challenges and position Zip as a transformational solution for efficiency and cost control.

  • Solution-sell with vision: Demonstrate Zip’s immediate impact while aligning with customers’ long-term digital transformation goals.

  • Shape the future: As an early sales leader in a hyper-growth startup, help refine Zip’s sales strategy, process, and team culture.

  • Leverage best-in-class sales tools: Utilize Salesforce, Clari, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Outreach to optimize outreach and pipeline management.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals.

  • Experience selling to procurement, finance, legal, IT, operations, supply chain, or manufacturing teams.

  • Proven success acquiring net-new logos in organizations with 10,000+ employees.

  • Skilled in complex sales cycles: Managing multiple stakeholders, navigating procurement processes, and driving consensus at the executive level.

  • Self-motivated and proactive: You take ownership of your success and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  • Exceptional communication and organization skills to manage multiple opportunities effectively.

Perks and Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget

 

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!
