jobs.title: Projectontwikkelaar vastgoed
jobs.description:
Wil jij bouwen aan de woningbouwopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.

 

Dit wordt jouw baan

Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling.

 

Wat ga je doen

Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie.

·       Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning tot aan de start van de realisatie;

·       Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's;

·       Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders;

·       Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken;

·       Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering;

·       Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming;

·       Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces;

·       Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie;

·       Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren projectontwikkelaars en krijgt de ruimte om op termijn een meer aansturende rol te vervullen.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.


Hier zit je op jouw plek

Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling.

Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen.

Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.


Dit breng jij mee

·       Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als projectontwikkelaar, ontwikkelmanager of vergelijkbare functie;

·       Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding;

·       Ervaring met woningbouwontwikkelingen;

·       Aantoonbare ervaring met projecten van substantiële omvang (200+ woningen is een pre).;

·       Ruime ervaring met ontwikkeltrajecten in de SO-, VO- en DO-fases, het verkrijgen van omgevingsvergunningen en verkooptrajecten;

·       Inzicht in bouwtechnische uitgangspunten om adviseurs aan te sturen en het plan verder uit te werken; 

·       Ervaring binnen een ontwikkelaar, ontwikkelende bouwer of vastgoedorganisatie.

Je bent een ontwikkelaar die vooral energie krijgt van de projecten na tendergunning verder te brengen richting realisatie. Je begrijpt de dynamiek van de bouw en weet hoe je samen met alle betrokken partijen woningbouwprojecten succesvol kunt ontwikkelen én realiseren.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Het salaris voor deze functie ligt bij een medior profiel tussen € 5.639,- en € 7.049,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur) en bij een senior profiel tussen € 6.512,- en € 9.512,- (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring.

  • Voor deze functie geldt een individuele bonusregeling, waarbij de hoogte van de bonus afhankelijk is van de behaalde resultaten.

  • Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra).

  • 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen;

  • Een laptop en een smartphone.

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap.

  • Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, een mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card. 

  • Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike.

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar ook op het gebied van vitaliteit.

  • Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland.

  • Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibel werken beleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical.

  • Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de 5 weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%.

jobs.title: Stage duurzame en innovatieve materiaaloplossingen voor betonconstructies
jobs.description:
Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stage lopen bij Dura Vermeer.

Hoe maak je een betonconstructie duurzamer, zonder in te leveren op veiligheid en kwaliteit? Tijdens deze stage bij Dura Vermeer Divisie Infra onderzoek jij welke materialen daaraan kunnen bijdragen. Je combineert constructieve berekeningen met duurzaamheid en ontdekt hoe we materiaalkeuzes maken voor infraprojecten. Volg jij een technische hbo- of wo-opleiding en zoek je een meewerk- of afstudeerstage? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Dit wordt jouw stage

Voor betonconstructies komen steeds meer nieuwe materiaaloplossingen beschikbaar. Maar een materiaal met een lagere milieu-impact is niet automatisch voor iedere toepassing de beste keuze. Ook de sterkte, kosten en verwerking op de bouwplaats tellen mee. Hoe vergelijk je die oplossingen op een eerlijke manier? Dat ga jij onderzoeken.

Samen met je begeleider kies je een betonconstructie die als basis dient voor jouw onderzoek. Je onderzoekt hoe verschillende materiaaloplossingen aan dezelfde technische eisen kunnen voldoen. Vervolgens vergelijk je de oplossingen op technische prestaties, milieu-impact, kosten en praktische toepasbaarheid.

Afhankelijk van jouw opleiding, interesses en leerdoelen ga je aan de slag met:

  • Het kiezen van een geschikte betonconstructie en het vaststellen van de eisen waaraan deze moet voldoen.

  • Het verzamelen van informatie over bestaande en innovatieve materiaaloplossingen.

  • Het uitwerken van materiaalvarianten en het maken van constructieve berekeningen.

  • Het vergelijken van de varianten: wat zijn de voordelen, beperkingen en aandachtspunten?

  • Het vertalen van jouw resultaten naar een advies voor onze collega’s.

Je legt je aanpak, berekeningen en conclusies vast in een rapport en presenteert je bevindingen aan het team. Daarmee help je onze collega’s om beter onderbouwde materiaalkeuzes te maken.

Je staat er tijdens je onderzoek niet alleen voor. Je werkt samen met constructeurs, ontwerpers en duurzaamheidsadviseurs en krijgt begeleiding van ervaren collega’s. Zo leer je hoe constructief ontwerp en duurzaamheid in de praktijk samenkomen. jobs.title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
jobs.description:
Background

Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice.

Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods.

Assignment

The assignment will include the following tasks:

  • A literature study on the qualification of machine learning algorithms in safety-critical sectors and on explainability methods for machine learning (e.g., attribution and saliency methods, example-based and concept-based explanations, interpretable models, uncertainty quantification), including the ways in which explanations themselves are evaluated.

  • A use case provided by NLR, for instance automated defect detection, and identification of the substantiation needed to qualify the algorithm, translated into criteria that explanations should meet.

  • Implementing several explainability methods for the use case and analysing them against these criteria, for example their faithfulness to the model, their robustness and their usefulness to domain experts.

  • Assessing how the resulting explanations can serve as evidence in the qualification of the algorithm, and formulating recommendations for the use of explainability in qualification.

Results

The final outcomes of this assignment will be:

§  A structured assessment, as part of a literature study, of explainability methods for machine learning and their suitability for qualification in aerospace, together with a justified selection of the use case.

§  An implementation and comparative evaluation of several explainability methods on the selected use case, with recommendations on how explainability can support the qualification of the algorithm.

§  A technical report, either an MSc thesis following the guidelines of your faculty or an internship report, describing the approach, results, and conclusions of the work.

Duration

For an MSc thesis, the standard duration of a thesis at your faculty applies (typically 9 months). For an internship, the duration is 6 months.

Profile

  • You are an MSc student in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics or a similar master.

  • You have a strong background in machine learning, preferably deep learning. Knowledge of explainable AI is a plus.

  • You have experience with programming in Python and with machine learning libraries, for instance PyTorch or scikit-learn.

  • You have an affinity with aerospace, inspection or certification, and are motivated to bring machine learning closer to qualified use in practice.

What we offer

  • A challenging graduation project/internship in a high-tech result orientated work environment

  • Weekly supervision and availability of the technical staff for support

  • An internship allowance

  • Working in an actual R&D project as part of the team

  • Internship results to be used in the current and future projects

About NLR

Royal NLR has been the ambitious research organisation with the will to keep innovating for over 100 years. With that drive, we make the world of transportation safer, more sustainable, more efficient and more effective. We are on the threshold of breakthrough innovations. Plans and ideas start to move when these are fed with the right energy. Over 800 driven professionals work on research and innovation, from aircraft engineers to psychologists and from mathematicians to application experts. Our colleagues are happy to tell you what it's like to work at NLR. This assignment will be managed by the Avionics Systems and Maintenance Engineering (ASAM) department.

jobs.title: Director, Advisory and Risk Consulting
jobs.description:
We are now seeking an experienced, commercially minded resilience management expert who can help clients anticipate, withstand and recover from complex disruptions while also building trusted, long-term client relationships. As the Director you will combine deep expertise in resilience, crisis, business continuity and risk management with the ability to manage existing accounts, and identify new opportunities to sell, originate and grow work in the German market. This role requires an individual with strong social skills, executive presence, a “refuse to lose” attitude, and the confidence to advise boards and senior executives, present ideas in a compelling way and translate complex thinking into clear, persuasive and structured client communications.

Business Development

  • Proactively manage accounts, identify prospects, build senior client relationships and generate new business opportunities for Control Risks, with a primary focus on corporate and government accounts throughout Germany.
  • Work closely with your advisory & risk consulting team, account managers, Service Line leaders and the Managing Director in a consultative sales capacity, entering client conversations as a subject matter expert, shaping opportunities and helping to close new work.
  • Own and deepen relationships with new and existing clients, demonstrating commercial persistence, high social intelligence and a “refuse to lose” approach to winning and retaining work.
  • Own and manage a qualified sales pipeline from prospecting and qualification through scoping, proposal development, negotiation and close, with clear accountability for converting opportunities into profitable work.
  • Develop targeted account plans by identifying the right accounts for Control Risks, prioritising growth accounts of relevant size and potential, mapping decision-makers and buyer groups, and pursuing cross-selling opportunities across service lines.
  • Author thought leadership on relevant topics, present at industry and network events, and help build both the Control Risks and personal brands.

Client Delivery

  • Advise clients on complex resilience management, security, crisis, business continuity and enterprise risk challenges, developing practical, sustainable approaches that can be understood and acted on by senior decision-makers.
  • Act as a senior project manager and trusted client adviser for Control Risks’ resilience and risk consulting projects, including assessing, designing, implementing and improving corporate security, resilience and risk management programmes, acting as the primary client contact and managing multidisciplinary delivery teams.
  • Provide clients with expert support and insights on risk strategy, organizational structures, Enterprise Risk, Business Continuity, Crisis, Security, Cyber Risk, Digital Risk or Intelligence Management.
  • Engage credibly with boards, executive committees and senior leadership teams, ensuring that business priorities are reflected in resilience and risk solutions and that recommendations are presented clearly, confidently and persuasively.
  • Collaboratively scope complex and multidimensional resilience projects with clients, using strong relationship-building and social skills to bring in diverse Control Risks teams and position the firm effectively for follow-on work
  • Own the full client delivery lifecycle from diagnostic assessment and solution design through implementation, stakeholder management, quality assurance and executive-level presentation of outcomes.
  • Use delivery work to identify client priorities, unmet needs and follow-on opportunities.
  • Manage engagement resourcing, budgets, margins and invoicing.

Requirements

Essential

  • Significant work experience in a consulting firm.
  • Direct, hands-on experience in selling and scoping consulting projects, including personally leading sales conversations, shaping client needs into project opportunities and converting those opportunities into won work
  • Established network in the relevant industry and market, with a degree of external recognition or profile that enables credible senior-level client engagement and supports business development.
  • Knowledge of best practices in resilience management, risk and security strategy, crisis preparedness, business continuity, organisational structures and executive decision-making under pressure.
  • Demonstrated expertise in resilience management, including risk and resilience programme development, security and crisis management, business continuity and organisational resilience optimisation.
  • Strong understanding of cyber and digital risks and how they intersect with resilience management, crisis preparedness, business continuity and senior-level risk decision-making.
  • Knowledge of data-driven approaches and understanding the impact of AI on resilience
  • Experience advising boards, executive committees and senior executives, including presenting complex recommendations in a compelling and commercially relevant way.
  • Strong presentation skills, with the ability to structure, visualise and communicate strategic thinking clearly and persuasively.
  • Business-level proficiency in German and English language.

Preferred

  • Experience in multiple industries and client operating environments
  • Ability to travel 50+% of the time and on short notice
  • Exceptional written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, including strong social skills and the ability to build trust quickly with senior clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Ownership, accountability and commercial resilience to drive success both within the team and across Control Risks.
  • The ability to multi-task and balance competing requirements, including client-facing, business development related, and internal matters
  • Committed, enthusiastic and commercially driven, with a “refuse to lose” attitude and a proactive approach to winning client confidence and new work.
  • A high level of integrity, loyalty and discretion
  • Willingness to learn and develop new skills
  • Executive presence, board-level confidence and the ability to present ideas and recommendations in a compelling, visually clear and persuasive way.

Benefits

  • Control Risks offers a competitively positioned compensation and benefits package that is transparent and summarised in the full job offer.
  • We operate a discretionary global bonus scheme that incentivises, and rewards individuals based on company and individual performance.
  • Control Risks supports hybrid working arrangements, wherever possible, that emphasise the value of in-person time together - in the office and with our clients - while continuing to support flexible and remote working.

Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

About Exeon

Exeon is a Swiss cyber security company based in Zurich. Since 2016, we have been protecting critical infrastructures, financial institutions and enterprises whose operations fully rely on IT through AI-powered analysis of network communication. This makes the most sophisticated cyberattacks visible – attacks conventional tools fail to detect. We combine Swiss excellence with a flexible, remote-first, and collaborative culture, supporting passionate, ambitious professionals devoted to solving cybersecurity challenges and driving continuous innovation.

What your impact will be like:

As a Security Engineer in our Solutions team, you will help design the components and data flow of our core products: how data gets in, how deployments are configured and operated, and how everything scales across very different customer environments, many of them on-prem and air-gapped. 

You’ll split your time between building (ingestion pipelines, automation, tooling) and deploying and operating (working with customers to get Exeon running reliably in their environments), so your work shapes both scalability and customer success.

In particular, you will:

  • Build tooling and automation to simplify the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of Exeon.NDR, Exeon.UEBA, log collection and supporting components 

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable log ingestion pipelines for a wide range of network and application log sources and formats, including parsing, normalization, and validation 

  • Deploy and operate Exeon in customer environments (on-prem, private cloud, and hybrid), including sizing, performance tuning, and troubleshooting complex issues 

  • Work with customers to understand their data sources, infrastructure constraints, and security needs, and translate these into clear requirements for product and engineering teams 

  • Contribute to customer support, documentation, and runbooks alongside your Solutions colleagues

What you can expect from us:

Exeon offers an open company culture that values and encourages diversity, teamwork and a growth mindset. Our goal is to provide our employees with an exciting, supportive and motivating environment for personal growth and career development while ensuring that our team maintains a healthy work-life balance. We strive to achieve this by offering:

  • An exciting and impactful job in a fast-growing Swiss cyber tech company expanding across Europe with manifold opportunities to shape your professional profile.

  • Working in close collaboration with our interdisciplinary team and learning from our Security Experts, Data Scientists, and Business Professionals.

  • Taking over responsibilities quickly and help shape and promote a cutting-edge security software.

  • A high degree of trust, independence and flexibility, also in terms of working hours and place of work (remote or in the office).

  • A competitive salary and appealing benefits package.


What you bring along:

We are looking for a proactive, self-motivated and enthusiastic cyber security professional who is comfortable in a high-paced start-up environment and who shares our values. You should be confident with solving problems independently and communicating easily with both internal teams and directly with customers. You should also:

  • 3-5 years of experience in systems engineering, data engineering, platform/infrastructure engineering, or a similar role 

  • Working knowledge of network and application security and the telemetry relevant to detection 

  • UNIX/Linux experience, including networking, troubleshooting, and performance tuning in containerized deployments (Docker and/or Kubernetes) 

  • Strong programming skills in Python and Bash (or comparable languages), with a focus on automation and maintainable, production-quality code 

  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data ingestion pipelines (e.g. syslog, Logstash/Fluentd/Vector, Elastic stack, or similar), including handling heterogeneous formats and high volumes 

  • Comfortable with working in a largely remote team where clear communication is key to successful collaboration and impact. We are an English-speaking team but German fluency is appreciated when communicating to some customers 

  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to have:

  • Solid understanding of network and application security fundamentals, common attack patterns, and the log and telemetry sources that matter for detection 

  • Experience with SIEM, SOAR, or detection platforms (e.g. Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Security), or as a detection engineer or security analyst 

  • Familiarity with network telemetry such as NetFlow/IPFIX, Zeek, or Suricata, and frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK 

  • Prior customer-facing or professional services experience.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description:
Bouw jij vandaag al aan het talent dat Athora morgen nodig heeft? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Recruitment bij Athora gaat verder dan het invullen van vacatures en interim opdrachten. We willen vooruitkijken: welke kennis, expertise en talenten hebben we nu en in de toekomst nodig en hoe zorgen we dat we deze tijdig aan ons binden? Wij helpen managers hun future fit teams bouwen.

Als Senior Recruiter combineer je strategisch recruitmentadvies met sterke operationele executie. Je bent gesprekspartner voor management en HR Business Partners, kent de arbeidsmarkt en brengt een eigen visie mee. Tegelijkertijd sta je midden in de dagelijkse recruitmentdynamiek. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen managers, HR Business Partners en kandidaten en zorgt ervoor dat ieder recruitmentproces soepel, zorgvuldig en persoonlijk verloopt.

Je hebt een sleutelrol in het aantrekken van het talent dat Athora nodig heeft om haar ambities voor vandaag én morgen te realiseren. Je verdiept je in wat er binnen de organisatie speelt, begrijpt de uitdagingen van verschillende bedrijfsonderdelen en vertaalt deze ontwikkelingen naar recruitmentoplossingen.

Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Je bent regisseur van het recruitmentproces. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen kandidaten, hiring managers en HR Business Partners en zorgt voor een professioneel én persoonlijk proces, van intake en werving tot selectie, aanbieding en onboarding. Je houdt tempo, stuurt actief op voortgang en zorgt dat afspraken en contacten zorgvuldig worden vastgelegd.

  • Je ondersteunt bij externe inhuur. Je adviseert managers over passende inzet, onderhandelt over tarief, duur en andere voorwaarden en draagt zorg voor een zorgvuldig proces en goede vastlegging.

  • Je brengt Recruitment verder als strategische gesprekspartner. Je vertaalt ontwikkelingen in de organisatie en op de arbeidsmarkt naar een heldere recruitmentaanpak en adviseert managers en HR Business Partners proactief over de personeelsbehoefte van vandaag én morgen.

  • Je maakt data leidend in recruitmentadvies en besluitvorming. Je ontwikkelt samen met het team onze visie op AI binnen Recruitment. Je onderzoekt waar AI het recruitmentproces slimmer en effectiever kan maken en helpt bepalen waar technologie waarde toevoegt én waar persoonlijk contact het verschil moet blijven maken.

  • Je benut recruitment- en arbeidsmarktdata om trends, knelpunten en kansen zichtbaar te maken, vertaalt deze naar impactvolle inzichten en gebruikt de data om gericht te adviseren en bij te sturen op onder andere instroom, doorlooptijd, kwaliteit en inzet van recruitmentkanalen.

  • Je bouwt mee aan de verdere professionalisering van Recruitment. Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze recruitmentstrategie, employer branding en kandidaat propositie. Je vertaalt nieuwe ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in werkwijze, processen en dienstverlening.


Wat vragen we van jou?

Je bent een stevige en verbindende recruitmentprofessional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie en uitvoering. Je bent nieuwsgierig en resultaatgericht. Je bent een gelijkwaardige gesprekspartner voor (senior) management en HR, je durft vanuit je expertise te adviseren en te challengen. Je stelt de juiste vragen en neemt een vacatureaanvraag niet automatisch voor gegeven aan. Je wil eerst begrijpen: wat is hier werkelijk nodig? Je weet mensen mee te krijgen in je aanpak. Tegelijkertijd houd je oog voor wat er in de dagelijkse recruitmentpraktijk nodig is en zorg je ervoor dat afspraken en processen zorgvuldig worden opgevolgd.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je hbo+/wo werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 7 jaar relevante ervaring in corporate recruitment;

  • werk je graag met data en AI en vertaalt inzichten naar concrete adviezen en acties;

  • werk je gestructureerd en accuraat en weet je hoe belangrijk goede vastlegging is voor een professioneel recruitmentproces en goede samenwerking binnen het team;

  • kun je overzicht houden over meerdere processen tegelijkertijd zonder de persoonlijke aandacht voor kandidaten en managers te verliezen;

  • heb je ervaring binnen financial services of een andere kennisintensieve en gereguleerde omgeving een pré;

  • beheers je zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift.


Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.


Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.


In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.


Salaris per maand:
Op basis van cao schaal 15 HAY (incl. CAO verhoging per 1 Januari 2027) is de range € 4.435,55 tot € 5.913,69 op basis van 36 uur.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
Why Coda
Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions.

With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia.

We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay, Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud, enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including  Codashop, Recharge.com, Startselect.com, and mobiletopup.co.uk, that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets.

Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you. 


The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join our close-knit commercial Legal team at Coda in Amsterdam, supporting a fast-growing business across fintech, payments, ecommerce and digital platforms.

This is an exciting opportunity to develop your skills and gain valuable experience in a truly international, digital-first company. You'll work in a dynamic, collaborative environment, with exposure to both our European businesses and the wider global Coda group.

The role is ideal for a commercially minded, proactive lawyer who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, applying legal expertise creatively and pragmatically to support business growth.

You will report to the Lead Counsel, Europe, who is based in India, and work closely with our global legal team and stakeholders across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Provide end-to-end legal support to Coda’s European businesses, advising on commercial contracts, product-related matters, corporate issues and general legal queries

  • Draft, review and negotiate a wide range of customer, partner, vendor and technology agreements, providing pragmatic advice on deal structuring, risk allocation and regulatory requirements

  • Act as a trusted legal partner to Product, Commercial, Engineering and Operations teams, supporting product launches, new features and go-to-market initiatives

  • Take ownership of key legal matters and projects, working independently and proactively while balancing commercial priorities and legal risks

  • Support strategic initiatives, including M&A projects, disputes, European regulatory matters and cross-border projects involving Coda’s global businesses

  • Collaborate with global legal, compliance, corporate secretarial, investigations and regulatory teams to ensure effective and consistent legal support across Europe

  • Contribute to the development of legal processes, templates and playbooks to support the business's continued growth and international expansion

  • Work closely with senior business stakeholders and the Lead Counsel, Europe, acting as a key legal point of contact for European matters and ensuring alignment on priorities and risks


What You'll Have

  • A Dutch-qualified lawyer with a Master’s degree in Law, preferably from a Dutch university, and at least 7 years of relevant experience in commercial or corporate law, ideally gained in-house or at a leading law firm

  • Strong experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial contracts, with sound commercial judgement and a pragmatic, business-focused approach to managing legal risk

  • Experience in fintech, payments, e-commerce, SaaS or digital platforms, with a good understanding of payments regulations and frameworks, including PSD2/PSD3, AML and EMD

  • Familiarity with handling commercial disputes, investigations and related legal matters

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Dutch and English, with the ability to explain complex legal matters clearly and concisely

  • Proactive, independent and hands-on, with the confidence to take ownership of legal matters, manage competing priorities and seek support when needed

  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, jurisdictions and time zones in an international environment

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, embracing the unique qualities of every individual, regardless of gender, race, age, religion, disability, or other local protected classes. Our goal is to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome and valued.
 
Due to the large number of exceptional applications we receive, we can only reach out to shortlisted candidates. If you don't hear from us, rest assured there may be another opportunity at Coda that aligns better with your unique abilities. Remember to check our Careers Page for more exciting job openings!

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About DeepJudge:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

 

About the role:
DeepJudge is a fast-growing venture-backed startup at the forefront of applying Artificial Intelligence in the legal domain. Founded by ex-Googlers and ETH PhDs, our mission is to help legal teams harness their collective knowledge so they can focus on the strategic aspects of their work. DeepJudge’s state-of-the-art knowledge retrieval system directs legal professionals to the internal insights that matter most, providing a strong foundation for AI-powered workflows. We’re headquartered in Zurich, with a team in the United States and Canada, and cater to clients all around the world.

We are looking for a thoughtful and strategic Product Marketing Manager to help shape how we communicate the value of AI-powered legal solutions to the market. As a subject matter expert on our products, you will craft compelling messaging, develop go-to-market strategies, and collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure our positioning resonates with customers.

This is an exciting opportunity for a marketer who is passionate about making complex technology approachable and valuable for legal professionals. You are a great fit for this role if you have a proven track record in B2B SaaS product marketing, a talent for crafting compelling messaging, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally to drive product launches, customer adoption, and market success.


What you’ll be doing

  • Craft compelling messaging and positioning that articulates the value of DeepJudge to our core audiences, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.

  • Lead the launch of new features and products, collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful adoption and engagement.

  • Act as a proactive advocate for DeepJudge’s product by sharing product features, use cases, and insights across the company.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders in Product, Marketing, and Commercial teams to create effective enablement materials and ensure alignment with strategic goals.

  • Gather and synthesize customer and market insights to provide actionable feedback that informs product development and enhances product-market fit.

  • Translate data and findings into actionable insights that drive decisions and fuel impactful product and feature updates.

Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 

Position description

We are looking for an experienced Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to design, build, and operate the identity platforms that secure access to our applications, infrastructure, and data. You will own the technical direction of our IAM ecosystem, including authentication, authorization, lifecycle management, and privileged access. You will work with security, IT, engineering, and compliance teams to deliver a secure, scalable, and user-friendly access experience aligned with Zero Trust principles.


What you will do

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise IAM solutions, including SSO, MFA, federation, and directory services.

  • Architect and manage identity lifecycle processes (joiner/mover/leaver), automating provisioning and deprovisioning across SaaS, cloud, and on-prem systems.

  • Implement and operate Privileged Access Management (PAM), including vaulting, session management, and just-in-time access.

  • Lead Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) initiatives such as access reviews, certifications, role-based access control (RBAC), and segregation-of-duties controls.

  • Integrate applications with the identity platform using SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and LDAP.

  • Develop automation and tooling (APIs, scripts, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code) to reduce manual identity operations.

  • Secure cloud identity and access across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including IAM policies, workload identity, and service accounts.

  • Define and enforce authentication and authorization standards, policies, and best practices.

  • Monitor identity-related threats and support detection and response for account compromise, credential abuse, and privilege escalation.


Experience and qualifications

  • 6 to 15 years of experience in IAM, security engineering, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major IAM platform such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Ping Identity, ForgeRock, SailPoint, or CyberArk.

  • Strong knowledge of identity protocols and standards: SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, and Kerberos.

  • Experience with Active Directory and directory services architecture.

  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, PowerShell, Go, Java, or JavaScript).

  • Solid understanding of cloud IAM models (AWS IAM, Azure RBAC, GCP IAM).

  • Experience with MFA, passwordless, and conditional or risk-based access.

  • Familiarity with Zero Trust, least privilege, and defense-in-depth principles.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden.

Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee.

  • Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap.

  • Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen.

  • In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

  • Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde.

  • Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten.

  • Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product.

jobs.title: Senior UX Designer - Map Visualisation
jobs.description:
TomTom's map is seen by millions of people every day - in dashboards, on phones, and across partner products worldwide. As a Senior UX Designer on the Map Visualisation team, you will shape how our 2D and 3D geospatial data is designed, styled and delivered across TomTom's product portfolio. 

You'll spend your days crafting multi-zoom map experiences, working with spatial data and collaborating closely with engineers and product managers to turn cartographic intent into production-ready map styles. You'll need to be as comfortable discussing label collision and style-layer specifications with engineers as you are refining colour palettes and visual hierarchy. 

This is a product role first. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional team that ships map rendering, map styles and SDKs used by other TomTom products and by the customers who build on our platform. You'll take part in the whole development lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through pull requests to release. Your product judgement, and your ability to bring people with competing priorities to a clear decision, matter here as much as your cartographic craft. 

AI is part of how we work. We expect you to use it to explore, prototype and ship faster, to know where it falls short, and to help shape map experiences in products where AI is part of the experience itself. 


What You'll Do

  • Design Compelling Map Experiences Create and refine 2D and 3D map visualisations from concept through production delivery. Own the end-to-end cartographic design process - from data exploration and sketching through to style implementation, QA and iteration across zoom levels, regions and use cases. 

  • Maintain and Evolve Core Map Styles Enhance TomTom's core map styles, ensuring consistency, readability and visual quality across platforms, screen densities and global markets. Balance aesthetic ambition with rendering performance and data constraints. 

  • Work as Part of the Product Team Work day-to-day alongside software engineers and product managers building TomTom's map data structures, renderers and SDKs. Take part in planning, refinement and reviews, provide design specifications engineers can act on, and review visual output during development and before release. 

  • Make and Own Trade-offs Help decide what ships, when and at what quality. Weigh visual fidelity against render budget, memory and frame rate on automotive and mobile hardware, customer requests against platform consistency, and scope against release dates. Reach a decision with the people who own the product, record it and see it through. 

  • Contribute to Renderer and Tooling Requirements Provide detailed input on the data and rendering capabilities needed to achieve design goals. Define requirements for internal cartographic authoring tools and identify workflow improvements that raise the team's output quality and speed. 

  • Bring AI into the Design Workflow Use AI to shorten the loop from idea to rendered map: generating and editing style-spec JSON, scripting data exploration, and building interactive prototypes on real data instead of static frames. Turn what works into shared workflows the team can reuse, and help define how we check AI-generated output for cartographic quality. 

  • Design for AI-Driven Map Experiences Contribute to how the map responds when the request comes from an AI system rather than a tap, for example in GeoAI answers, conversational search or agent-generated routes. Work out how the map shows what the AI found, how confident it is and when it is wrong. 

  • Inform Decisions with Research and Data Participate in user research, customer conversations and competitive benchmarking. Use insights to ground design decisions and advocate for improvements that address real user needs. 

  • Support the Design System and Standards Contribute to the Map Visualisation design system - documenting patterns, conventions and cartographic guidelines that enable consistency and scale across the product portfolio. 


What You'll Need

Leadership & Product Team Experience 

  • A track record of shaping product direction from the design seat. You set out the options, make the case for one and bring engineering, product and business stakeholders with you. 

  • A track record of shipping software as a designer embedded in a product team, ideally on map, location or developer-platform products: SDKs, APIs, map styles or tooling that other teams and companies build on. 

  • A clear understanding of how products move from discovery to release and beyond, including planning, roadmaps and measuring results after launch. You know how versioned releases, deprecations and backwards compatibility shape design choices on a platform with external customers. 

  • Hands-on familiarity with how software gets built: backlogs, refinement, estimation, definition of done, Git, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD, feature flags and release trains. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand how your designs move through a rendering pipeline and into a release. 

  • Sound judgement under constraint. You can point to decisions where you gave something up to ship, and explain why it was right for the product and its users. 

  • Clarity with senior audiences. You can turn a complex design problem into a short, well-argued recommendation and own the result. 

  • Comfort with disagreement. You challenge a decision with evidence, accept the outcome when it goes the other way and keep the work moving. 

  • Experience contributing to solution design documents, technical specifications and cross-functional planning. 

Cartography & Digital Map Making 

  • A solid foundation in digital cartography, GIS or geographic information design. If your map-making depth is still growing, show us how fast you are closing the gap, including how you use AI to learn. 

  • Experience designing multi-zoom digital maps with attention to cartographic conventions, label placement, generalisation and cultural adaptation. 

  • Working proficiency with key mapping technologies and ecosystems: MapLibre, Mapbox GL JS, OpenStreetMap data and tooling, QGIS, ArcGIS, Leaflet, OpenLayers or comparable platforms. 

  • Experience working with diverse spatial datasets - vector tiles, raster tiles, GeoJSON, shapefiles, point clouds or terrain data. 

  • Awareness of cartographic standards across regions and cultures, including sensitive topics such as disputed borders and local place names. 

Map Visualisation & Rendering 

  • Demonstrated ability to build visually compelling 2D and 3D map experiences - from thematic styling and terrain visualisation to street-level detail. 

  • Hands-on experience designing 3D map content such as buildings, terrain, landmarks and lane-level road geometry, in stylised or realistic form. You understand how LOD, lighting, materials and camera pitch affect legibility and performance. 

  • Experience with 3D data formats and pipelines such as glTF and 3D Tiles, and how 3D assets are prepared and optimised for real-time map rendering. 

  • Good understanding of real-time rendering concepts as they apply to maps: style layers, zoom interpolation, data-driven styling, symbol rendering and performance considerations. 

AI in Your Practice 

  • Evidence that AI has changed how you work. Be ready to show a real example, such as a map style, data visualisation or coded prototype built with AI, and tell us where it let you down. 

  • Sharp judgement of AI output. You can spot errors in generated work and know which decisions still need a designer's eye. 

  • Experience turning personal AI use into workflows the team shares, within the limits of confidential data and licensing. 

Senior-Level Craft & Collaboration 

  • 5+ years of professional experience in UX, product or cartographic design, with most of that time spent inside software product teams. 

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cartography, Geography, GIS, UX Design, Computer Science or a related field - or equivalent professional experience. 

  • Ability to build clear, concise prototypes and specification documentation that bridge design and engineering. 

  • Strong visual and graphic design fundamentals - typography, colour theory, hierarchy and layout. 

  • User-centric mindset with a collaborative, low-ego approach to problem-solving. 

  • High attention to detail and a real passion for the craft of map making. 


Nice to Have

  • Experience with game engines or 3D content pipelines (Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender) and their application to geospatial visualisation. 

  • Familiarity with front-end languages and graphics APIs (JavaScript/TypeScript, WebGL, WebGPU, GLSL) or scripting for cartographic automation (Python, PostGIS, Overpass API). With AI, even basic coding skills go a long way. 

  • Experience with map data processing tools and pipelines: Tippecanoe, Tilemaker, osm2pgsql, Mapnik or similar. 

  • Understanding of the automotive, fleet management or logistics industries and their mapping requirements. 

  • Familiarity with emerging trends in spatial computing, AR navigation or digital twins. 

  • Experience contributing to design systems at scale. 

What we offer

A competitive compensation package, of course.  

Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. 

Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.  

Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.

Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. 

Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.  

Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. 

Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. 

Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! 

Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. 

Meet your team

We’re the User Experience Design team. Fueled by user insights and data analytics, our mission is to create powerful, easy-to-use products that delight our customers, from millions of drivers to automotive customers who embed our technologies in their vehicles. We deliver the design specifications for all TomTom’s products. Joining us, you'll be part of a team that brings together design disciplines from user research to interaction, concept and visual design. Together, we'll continue to develop a map that people trust all around the world.


At TomTom...

You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.

Work with a team of 3,600+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.


After you apply

Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs.


TomTom is an equal opportunity employer

TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, you. No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. If you can relate to this, please know that we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About Deepdesk

Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. As part of AnywhereNow, a global leader in customer experience technology with 220 colleagues worldwide, we combine the agility of a scale-up with the strength of an established enterprise provider.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside.

At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks.

You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets.

We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go.

We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving.


What You’ll Be Doing

•  Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python and Go, with background processing for heavy work.

•  Keep our databases fast and reliable.

•  Run and improve our infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines.

•  Build and run the real-time voice agent services: speech to text, language model and text to speech, with low latency, in Python and Go.

•  Help deploy and run the machine learning services behind our recommendations. Machine learning experience is not required.

•  Design and provide complete and accurate end-to-end metrics.

•  Write and review well-tested, clean and maintainable code.

•  Follow software engineering best practices while staying pragmatic and avoiding over-engineering.

•  Contribute to front-end features in TypeScript and React when needed.

Our Stack

•  Backend: Python (Django REST framework, FastAPI and Celery) and Go.

•  Voice: Go for our real-time voice AI service, with WebSockets, speech to text, language models, text to speech and the OpenAI Realtime API.

•  Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch.

•  Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Flux and Cloud Build.

•  Front end: TypeScript and React.

•  Quality: automated tests (pytest, and BDD integration tests written in Go), code review on every change, and automation to keep our code and delivery practices in shape.

What We’re Looking For

•  Strong professional experience building backend services in Python or Go. In Python, Django or FastAPI is a plus.

•  Solid knowledge of relational databases, in particular PostgreSQL.

•  Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Google Cloud is a plus.

•  Working knowledge of TypeScript and React, enough to build and fix front-end features. It does not need to be your strength.

•  A disciplined approach to testing, code review, maintainability and delivery.

•  Comfort working with autonomy and taking full ownership in a fast-moving environment.

•  Interest in voice and real-time systems, and willingness to also work in the other language. Our voice AI service and our integration tests are written in Go, and most of the backend is in Python.

•  A plus: experience with Celery, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, serving machine learning models, or real-time audio.

Why Join Us?

•  Based in the Netherlands, with flexibility over how you organise your time. [HR: confirm office and hybrid details]

•  A small team working with major enterprise clients.

•  Start-up culture combined with enterprise demands and production scale.

•  Full autonomy and full ownership of your work.

•  High standards, trust and plenty of humour.

•  The opportunity to shape real-time AI experiences used in enterprise contact centres.

•  Full-time (40 hours), permanent contract.

Information Security Responsibilities

All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organisation’s information security standards. This includes:

•  Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

•  Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

•  Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

•  Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

•  Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

  • User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
jobs.description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

jobs.title: Remote Financial Services Agent (Independent Contractor) – Inbound Card & Account Support
jobs.description:
Set your own hours, take inbound banking card calls from home, and earn up to $350 in certification bonuses. The contract has a pool of 20,000+ hours of work available every month.

Earnings at a Glance

  • $15.00–$17.00 per hour, plus performance incentives

  • $300 certification bonus once you complete 200 productive hours

  • +$50 bonus if you certify within 6 weeks

  • Choose your own hours. Coverage runs 24/7, every day

  • Remote, U.S.-based, 1099 independent contractor

The Opportunity

Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their cards for everyday life. They might be activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. These moments matter, and you're the person who makes them go smoothly.

What the Work Involves

  • Inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions

  • Payments, transfers, and disputes, handled accurately and securely

  • Identity verification and strict security and compliance protocols on every call

  • Spotting potential fraud and helping resolve it with composure

  • Accurate documentation of every interaction

You're a Fit If You Bring

  • Clear, empathetic phone communication, even when callers are stressed

  • Care for protecting sensitive financial information

  • Comfort moving between multiple systems at once

  • Composure and problem-solving in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong plus: banking, card, financial services, or contact center experience

Your Path to Starting Work

  1. Week 1: Apply. Create your ShyftOff account and apply to the Financial Services campaign.

  2. Weeks 2–3: Screening & credentialing. Federal background check, fingerprinting, drug screening, and credential issuance.

  3. Weeks 4–5: Certification. Simulations and scored mock calls. Standards and examples of required work product are demonstrated.

  4. Week 6: Practice calls & go-live. Show that your work meets the program's accuracy and quality standards, then start choosing open hours.

Screening Cost: Please Read Before Applying

This is a federally backed program, so every contractor must complete third-party credentialing before taking live calls. As an independent contractor, you pay these providers directly:

  • Extensive federal background check

  • Fingerprinting

  • Drug screening

  • YubiKey security device (yours to keep)

Total: $299, paid to third-party providers. It's due only when you move into credentialing, not at sign-up.

What You'll Need

  • Ability to pass federal background, fingerprint, and drug screening

  • A quiet home workspace and reliable high-speed internet

  • Commitment to completing self-paced certification (about 6 weeks)

How to Apply

  1. Create your agent account at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents

  2. Apply to the Financial Services campaign from your dashboard

This is an independent contractor (1099) opportunity. You set your own schedule, work remotely, and provide your own workspace and equipment.

jobs.title: Data Analyst (No Experience Required)
jobs.description:
For thousands of years, maps have provided humans with the knowledge they need to make decisions. As a Maps Evaluator, you will have the opportunity to provide ground truth for your town, city or country.

 

At Peroptyx, we are looking for Data Analysts who will review mapping data for digital mapping applications. Your research capabilities will validate and ensure that the navigation of certain routes are accurate and safe.

 

As part of this role you will verify that business names and opening hours are correct. You will check that the distance from a starting point to an end destination is listed accurately, resulting in better user experiences.

 

With this job you can plan your days around this highly flexible working schedule, work weekends or late evenings, all from the comfort of your own office. The flexibility of our roles minimizes the impact on your daily routine.

 

So, whether you are a student looking to earn as you learn, a retiree looking for a new challenge, a part-time/full time professional or a work from home parent, Peroptyx has the right role for you!

 

Benefits

  • Work up to 20 hours per week.

  • Earn a competitive rate of pay.

  • Develop your research skills.

  • Avoid the long commute.

  • Work from the comfort of your home office.

  • Enjoy the flexibility of setting your own working hours!

 

Ideal Candidate

  • Fluent in English and Japanese.

  • Excellent research skills.

  • Excellent local knowledge of your home country.

  • Good understanding and general knowledge of the geography and culture of Japan.

  • Analytical mindset.

 

Job Requirements

  • Must be living in Japan for a minimum of 5 consecutive years.

  • Must pass an online open-book exam that can verify your full understanding of the material and concepts.

  • Must be willing to work a minimum of 10 hours and up to 20 hours per week depending on task availability.

  • Good working knowledge of search engines, map applications and familiarity with social media platforms.

  • Strong ability to learn, understand and apply multiple sets of different instructions.

  • All work must be of an independent nature.

 

Apply Online Today!

jobs.title: AI Content Analyst (No Experience Required)
jobs.description:
Help Shape the Future of AI — From Anywhere

 

AI is revolutionising how we interact with technology. From news feeds to navigation, machine learning can tailor our digital experiences to meet our needs — anytime, anywhere.

 

With Peroptyx, you’ll have an opportunity to help make those experiences even smarter. We're looking for AI Content Analysts to assess the accuracy and relevance of human and AI-generated content.

You’ll evaluate everything from search results to news stories, images, music and transit data — ensuring it all makes sense in the real world.

 

What’s in it for you?

 

✅ Total flexibility — set your own hours (weekends, evenings, whenever suits you)

✅ Fully remote — work from home, skip the commute

✅ Earn a competitive hourly rate

✅ Boost your research and analytical skills

 

Whether you're a student, a parent, a professional seeking part-time hours, or just someone who loves a flexible role — this is an opportunity to make a real impact from your home location.

 

You’ll Succeed If You Are:

  1. Fluent in English

  2. A sharp researcher with great local knowledge (news, culture, media)

  3. Familiar with search engines, maps, and social platforms

  4. Analytical, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently

  5. Living in your country for 5+ consecutive years

 

Requirements:

  1. Minimum 10–20 hours/week availability

  2. Must pass an online open-book assessment

  3. Laptop/PC with unique user account & up-to-date antivirus

  4. Only one applicant per household

  5. All tools/equipment at your own expense

 

Help train the next generation of AI — on your time, your terms

Join the Peroptyx Team — Apply Online Today!

 

Note: This is a freelance, independent contractor position.
